'''John Ford''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2000 Rochester tournament (16 September)]] on 16 September 2000 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base S-Foils]], according to R. Smith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1255">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-20-rochester-ny-9-16-2000d1255/ rochester-ny-9-16-2000], DeckTech (R. "Voice of Law" Smith, 20 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-20-rochester-ny-9-16-2000d1255/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
